summaries.plain:
Currency rounding and billing-worker fixes are complete and validated. Rounding coverage includes mixed inputs, omitted precision, scales 0–5, high-precision boundaries, and invalid negative precision; all 6 focused tests passed, with the earlier full suite at 184 passed and 2 skipped. The worker retry/memory fix copies incoming batches before extending `pending_events` and removes the obsolete `_last_batch`; regression tests confirm completed events do not leak across batches and pending events remain retryable. All 41 worker tests passed, a 5,000-batch reproduction showed stable memory and zero pending events, and the full suite passed with 118 passed and 7 skipped.

CLI billing filters are centralized in `_add_billing_filters(parser)`. The shared currency argument has `dest="currency"`, duplicate invoice currency options were removed, help shows one `--currency/-c`, and abbreviations such as `--curr` and `--sta` are covered. A stale comment claiming date filters remained command-specific was removed. All 37 CLI/command tests pass; Ruff and `git diff --check` are clean.

Deployment `api-2-8-0-schema` succeeded. A two-replica `payments-api-rc3-canary` was created from image `2.8.0-rc.2`; rollout verification is still pending. Execute one exact deployment command at a time, stop on failure, and use `#deploy-basalt`. Configurable maximum dunning-attempt priority remains unimplemented. DST, SQLAlchemy modernization, pagination, and logging are substantially complete; remaining work includes `print()` review and visual PDF comparison. Preserve approval, license-check, migration, privacy, and multi-key rename requirements.
